meta.title: Why Study in China?
meta.description: China offers not only quality and affordable education, but also rich culture, modern technologies, and extensive career opportunities.

hero.title: Why Study in China?
hero.subtitle: China offers not only quality and affordable education, but also rich culture, modern technologies, and extensive career opportunities.

benefits.title: Main Benefits of Studying in China
benefits.subtitle: Studying in China means not only quality education but also extensive opportunities for the future.

items.title: High-Quality Education
items.description: Chinese universities rank highly in global rankings and are equipped with modern curricula and highly qualified teachers.

items.title: Affordable Prices
items.description: Much more affordable tuition and living costs compared to Western countries, along with numerous scholarship opportunities.

items.title: Internationally Recognized Degrees
items.description: Degrees from Chinese universities are recognized worldwide and highly valued in the international job market.

items.title: Career Opportunities
items.description: China's economy is one of the fastest growing in the world, offering graduates extensive career opportunities.

items.title: Learning Chinese Language
items.description: Opportunity to learn one of the most spoken languages in the world, which provides a significant advantage in the future.

items.title: Cultural Experience
items.description: Opportunity to learn about a rich culture with 5,000 years of history and make international friends.

topUniversities.title: Top Chinese Universities
topUniversities.subtitle: Chinese universities rank highly in global rankings and provide quality education.

costComparison.title: Education Cost Comparison
costComparison.subtitle: Studying in China is much more affordable compared to other popular education destinations
costComparison.disclaimer: * Prices are approximate and may vary depending on university and program

careerOpportunities.title: Career Opportunities
careerOpportunities.subtitle: Studying in China opens up a wide range of career opportunities for graduates

chinaUzbekistan.title: China-Uzbekistan Relations
chinaUzbekistan.description: China is one of Uzbekistan's largest trading partners. Trade and economic relations between the two countries are continuously developing, increasing the demand for specialists educated in China.

culturalExperience.title: Cultural Experience
culturalExperience.subtitle: Studying in China is not only about education but also an opportunity to learn about rich culture and traditions

testimonials.title: Student Testimonials
testimonials.subtitle: Experiences of Uzbek students studying in China

studyOptions.title: Study Options
studyOptions.subtitle: There are various study options available in China

bachelor.title: Bachelor
bachelor.heading: Bachelor Programs
bachelor.description: Bachelor programs typically last 4-5 years, and students gain in-depth knowledge and skills in their fields. Many programs are taught in English.

master.title: Master
master.heading: Master Programs
master.description: Master programs typically last 2-3 years, and students gain specialized knowledge and research skills in their fields.

phd.title: PhD
phd.heading: PhD Programs
phd.description: PhD programs typically last 3-5 years, and students conduct in-depth research in their fields and prepare for academic degrees.

language.title: Language Courses
language.heading: Chinese Language Courses
language.description: In Chinese language courses, students learn Chinese and immerse themselves in the culture. These courses can last from 6 months to 2 years.

cta.title: Apply to Study in China
cta.description: Our specialists will help you choose the right program and assist you in the application process.
